paper_title: Excess Electronic Recoil Events in XENON1T
notes: The paper reports a solar axion excess and a 3D 90% confidence surface for axion couplings to electrons, photons, and nucleons, inscribed in a cuboid: gae < 3.8e-12, gae*gan_eff < 4.8e-18, gae*gagamma < 7.7e-22 GeV^-1. These are single-value bounds (not mass-dependent curves), as solar axions are nearly massless. The paper also constrains bosonic dark matter (ALPs/dark photons) as mono-energetic peaks vs mass from 1-210 keV, but those numerical curve points are not tabulated in the provided text. Local DM density of 0.3 GeV/cm^3 is assumed for the bosonic DM search (Eq. 12). No extractable (mass, coupling) data pairs available from the provided content for the AxionElectron limit curve. The solar axion result is a single bound, not a mass-curve. | read-vote N=3: ct=AxionElectron (3/3); no consensus curve, took most-points
